headline: From Trudeau cabinet minister to Ontario Liberal leader: Who is Navdeep Bains?
summary: The stories that stayed in the briefing most this week: From Trudeau cabinet minister to Ontario Liberal leader: Who is Navdeep Bains?; Trump vows to work with Democrats to cap credit card interest rates at 10%; Thousands protest across Europe over living costs and housing.
